cohort: The cohort consisted of 29 patients aged 14 years or older with Exstrophy-epispadias complex (EEC) who had surgery at a tertiary referral institution with at least 12 months of follow-up.
finding: Patients with Exstrophy-epispadias complex (EEC) can achieve good long-term sexual and urinary outcomes, though often requiring multiple surgeries, with good sexual outcomes linked to good urinary and continence outcomes.
